blocks.text: The delegates of the 2026 Miss Asia Pacific International pageant continued their exploration of Cebu and went to the northern part of the province to experience the diversity of Cebuano culture. The ladies went to the coastal city of Danao on the northeastern portion of the main island on Wednesday, Sept. 30, and was welcomed by former Cebu 5th District Rep. Red Durano. They then proceeded to Bantayan Island on the same day and greeted the people of the town of Santa Fe, another coastal municipality, and even paid a courtesy visit at the municipal hall.
